result.brief: 研究物理结构（守恒量监督、对称性表征、结构化动力学）如何注入预测式世界模型，并在行星运动与JEPA式视觉模型中评估其对长时序rollout与泛化的影响。
result.reason: Studies how physical structure (conserved quantities, symmetry-aware representations, JEPA-style visual models) improves predictive world models and long-horizon rollouts, directly addressing world-model representation learning.
